## Tuesday, November 17

### Dubai Basketball vs. Anadolu Efes Istanbul (17:00 CET)

##### Dubai

Dubai has not yet sent an injury report for its game against Efes on Tuesday.

- Thomas Walkup last played in Round 6.
- Davis Bertans last played in Round 9.
- Justin Anderson made his season debut in the ABA League last week but did not play in Round 11, nor in the domestic league this past weekend.

##### Efes

Bruno Fernando, Isaia Cordinier and Mike James are ruled out for Efes's game at Dubai on Tuesday, the club has confirmed.

- PJ Dozier returned to action in Round 11.
- [Bruno Fernando is out for 3-4 weeks](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/news/efess-bruno-fernando-to-miss-3-4-weeks-with-calf-injury/) after a calf injury sustained in Round 11.
- [Mike James suffered an Achilles injury in Round 3](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/news/mike-james-achilles-surgery-anadolu-efes/) that will see him sidelined for 7-9 months.
- Isaia Cordinier remains sidelined after undergoing surgery in May, as [was announced on May 18](https://x.com/AnadoluEfesSK/status/2056451478508712239).

### Maccabi Rapyd Tel Aviv vs. Olympiacos Piraeus (18:00 CET)

##### Maccabi

Maccabi has not yet sent an injury report for its game against Olympiacos on Tuesday.

- Iffe Lundberg will be out until December with a [partial tear of his quadriceps](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/en/euroleague/news/maccabi-to-be-without-lundberg-for-6-8-weeks/).

##### Olympiacos

Nikola Milutinov, Jean Montero and Tyler Dorsey are ruled out for Olympiacos's game at Maccabi on Tuesday, the club has confirmed.

- [John Konchar left Olympiacos](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/news/john-konchar-leaves-olympiacos/) on November 16.
- Kostas Papanikolaou was ruled out for Round 11.
- Bryant Dunston was unavailable in Round 11.
- Antonios Karagiannidis, George Papas and Georgios Bourneles were also out in Round 11.
- Tyler Dorsey last played in Round 5 after being suspended by the club.
- Jean Montero last played in Round 6. He is ruled out for six months after knee surgery, [the club announced on October 30](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/news/jean-montero-knee-surgery-olympiacos/).

### Zalgiris Kaunas vs. FC Bayern Munich (19:00 CET)

##### Zalgiris

Zalgiris has not yet sent an injury report for its game against Bayern on Tuesday.

- Nigel Williams-Goss last played in Round 6. He is dealing with a hamstring injury.
- Dovydas Giedraitis last played in Round 7.
- Deividas Sirvydis last played in Round 6.
- Marek Blazevic last played in Round 7.

##### Bayern

Bayern has not yet sent an injury report for its game at Zalgiris on Tuesday.

- Tobas Jensen last played in Round 9.
- Niels Giffey last played in Round 9.
- [Kamar Baldwin left the club to join Maccabi](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/news/maccabi-signs-kamar-baldwin-bayern-munich/) on November 10.

### Fenerbahce Tarfin Istanbul vs. LDLC ASVEL Villeurbanne (19:00 CET)

##### Fenerbahce

Nicolo Melli and Braxton Key are Fenerbahce's only absentees for its game against ASVEL on Tuesday, the club has confirmed.

- Nicolo Melli was a late scratch for Round 11.
- Sertac Sanli, who was a game-time decision for Round 11, did not play either. 
- [Chris Silva left the club to join Partizan](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/news/partizan-signs-chris-silva-fenerbahce/) on November 13.

##### ASVEL

ASVEL has not yet sent an injury report for its game at Fenerbahce on Tuesday.

- Myles Cale last played in Round 7.
- Edwin Jackson last played in Round 10.
- Yves Pons last played in Round 10.
- Mathis Dossou-Yovo made his first appearance of the season in Round 11.
- Juhann Begarin, [who joined ASVEL on a short-term deal](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/news/juhann-begarin-joins-asvel-villeurbanne/) on October 7, has not yet played for the team in the EuroLeague.

### FC Barcelona vs. Paris Basketball (20:30 CET)

##### Barcelona

Barcelona has not yet sent an injury report for its game against Paris on Tuesday.

- Umoja Gibson suffered an injury in Round 11 and is out for three weeks, [Barcelona announced on November 15](https://x.com/FCBbasket/status/2121985074568519821).
- Juan Nunez last played in Round 8. He was on the gameday roster in the Spanish League this past weekend but didn't play.
- [Kevin Punter](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/news/barcelona-battered-by-injuries-to-kevin-punter-tosan-evbuomwan/) has suffered a sprain to his left ankle and is expected to be out until the end of December.
- [Tosan Evbuomwan](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/news/barcelona-battered-by-injuries-to-kevin-punter-tosan-evbuomwan/) has a tear in the oblique muscle of his abdominal wall and is expected to be out until early December.
- Yoan Makoundou has not played so far this season as he recovers from a knee injury.

##### Paris

Paris has not yet sent an injury report for its game at Barcelona on Tuesday.

- Joel Ayayi last played in Round 10.
- Daulton Hommes last played in Round 8, but he has played in Paris's last two French League games.
- Maozinha Pereira last played in Round 10, but he has played in Paris's last two French League games.

### Armani Olimpia Milan vs. Crvena Zvezda Meridianbet Belgrade (20:30 CET)

##### Milan

Devin Booker remains Milan's only absentee for its game against Crvena Zvezda on Tuesday, the club has confirmed.

- Devin Booker suffered a torn tendon in his right thigh in Round 9 and has been out ever since.

##### Crvena Zvezda

Johnathan Motley and Stefan Miljenovic are ruled out for Crvena Zvezda's game at Milan on Tuesday, the club has confirmed.

- Johnathan Motley "could not practice due to a virus and is out of the team for this game," coach Ibon Navarro said ahead of Round 11. He is also ruled out for Round 12 due to flu.
- Ebuka Izundu last played in Round 10. He is listed as available for Round 12.
- Vojin Medarevic is out for Round 11 due to high temperature. He is listed as available for Round 12.
- [Stefan Miljenovic](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/en/euroleague/news/zvezdas-stefan-miljenovic-out-after-ankle-surgery/) had ankle surgery before Round 11. He is also ruled out for Round 12.

### Kosner Baskonia Vitoria-Gasteiz vs. Hapoel IBI Tel Aviv (20:30 CET)

##### Baskonia

Baskonia has not yet sent an injury report for its game against Hapoel on Tuesday.

- [New signing Rolands Smits](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/news/baskonia-signs-rolands-smits-boosts-frontcourt/) has been registered and could make his debut in Round 12.
- [New signing Kenan Kamenjas](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/news/baskonia-brings-big-man-kenan-kamenjas-on-loan-from-dubai/) has been registered and could make his debut in Round 12.
- Rodions Kurucs returned to action in Round 11.
- [Kenneth Faried suffered a left thigh injury](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/news/kenneth-faried-adds-to-baskonia-injury-problems/) in Round 11.
- Marcio Santos last played in Round 9.
- Tadas Sedekerskis last played in Round 7.

##### Hapoel

Hapoel has not yet sent an injury report for its game at Baskonia on Tuesday.

- Tomas Satoransky, who missed Round 10 due to a a head injury suffered in Round 9, returned to action in Round 11.
- Jacob Toppin last played in Round 10.
- Bruno Caboclo last played in Round 10 and was not on the gameday roster in Round 11.
- Khadeen Carrington last played in Round 8.
- Bar Timor and Tamir Blatt have not played in the EuroLeague this season.

### Partizan Mozzart Bet Belgrade vs. Valencia Basket (20:45 CET)

##### Partizan

Derek Willis is a game-time decision while Ethan Thompson and Kevarrius Hayes are ruled out for Partizan's game against Valencia on Tuesday, the club has confirmed.

- [New signing Chris Silva](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/news/partizan-signs-chris-silva-fenerbahce/) has been registered and could make his debut in Round 12.
- Lamar Stevens did not play in Round 11 due to illness. He is listed as available for Round 12.
- Kyle Allman last played in Round 8. He missed Round 11 due to illness. He is listed as available for Round 12.
- Kevarrius Hayes last played in Round 9. He missed Round 11 due to a shoulder injury.
- Tonye Jekiri returned to action in Round 11.
- Derek Willis has been sidelined with an [ankle injury](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/en/euroleague/news/derek-willis-injury-further-depletes-partizan-frontcourt/) he suffered in Round 1. He is listed as a game-time decision for Round 12.

##### Valencia

Nikola Mirotic and Nate Reuvers are Valencia's only absentees for its game at Partizan on Tuesday, the club has confirmed.

- Nate Reuvers (foot) last played in Round 7.
- Nikola Mirotic last played in Round 8 due to injury.
- Yankuba Sima has not played in the EuroLeague this season.

### Virtus Bologna vs. Panathinaikos AKTOR Athens (21:00 CET)

##### Virtus

Davide Casarin is Virtus's only absentee for its game against Panathinaikos on Tuesday, the club has confirmed.

- Daniel Hackett was ruled out for Round 11 but is listed as available for Round 12.
- Davide Casarin has been ruled out for the last two rounds.
- Tommaso Baldasso has been ruled out since Round 8.

##### Panathinaikos

Lefteris Mantzoukas remains Panathinaikos's only absentee for its game at Virtus, the club has confirmed.

- Lefteris Mantzoukas has been ruled out for the last two rounds. He last played in Round 6.
- Panagiotis Kalaitzakis last played in Round 9.
- Dimitris Moraitis last played in Round 6.
- Nikos Rogkavopolous last played in Round 5.
## Wednesday, November 18

### Besiktas Istanbul vs. Real Madrid (18:00 CET)

##### Besiktas

Besiktas has not yet sent an injury report for its game against Real Madrid on Wednesday.

- Jaylen Nowell was ruled out for Round 11.
- Berk Ugurlu was ruled out for Round 11. He last played in Round 9.
- DaQuan Jeffries, who suffered a wrist injury in Round 1, returned to action in Round 11.

##### Real Madrid

Real Madrid has not yet sent an injury report for its game at Besiktas on Wednesday.

- [Theo Maledon sprained his knee](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/news/theo-maledon-mikael-jantunen-injuries-real-madrid/) in Round 9 and missed the last two rounds. He returned to action in the Spanish League this past weekend.
- [Mikael Jantunen ruptured his plantar fascia](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/news/theo-maledon-mikael-jantunen-injuries-real-madrid/) in Round 9 and has been out ever since.
- [Facundo Campazzo is dealing with a hamstring injury](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/news/real-madrids-medical-misery-mounts-as-facundo-campazzo-goes-down/). He last played in Round 9.
- Gaby Deck (shoulder) last played in Round 3, with coach Pedro Martinez saying ahead of Round 4: "The injury is more serious than we thought." 
- [Usman Garuba suffered an Achilles injury](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/news/usman-garuba-to-undergo-surgery-after-season-ending-achilles-tear/) at last May's Final Four.
